## Problem

Describe the problem and link an issue when available.

## Change

Explain the focused change and any browser-storage compatibility effects.

## Verification

List commands actually run and results. State unverified checks plainly.

## Risks

Describe remaining risks and recovery steps for storage or hosting changes.

- [ ] Tests cover changed behaviour.
- [ ] Documentation matches usage.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, generated builds or local state are included.
- [ ] Security checks are not weakened or bypassed.
- [ ] Contributions are compatible with the MIT License.
